I have taught undergraduate econometrics and principles of microeconomics as instructor of
record, and have supported Ph.D., M.A., and undergraduate courses as a teaching assistant since
2022. I received the **Harold Elder Teaching Award** for best economics graduate student in
2025, and **Outstanding Teaching by a Doctoral Student** from the Culverhouse College of
Business in 2026.

## Course materials

I build my courses from scratch in LaTeX — lecture notes, problem sets and answer keys, exams,
and R tutorial scripts that walk students through estimation in code rather than only on paper.
